scope: token usage of the Claude Code stream-json profile: every native member whose key names tokens (SourceAvailability.TOKEN_KEY) in the registered recordings of the bindings below, and every member inside an obligation's payload. Members outside this family (durations, counts, statuses, content) are not judged by this catalog; the field-disposition catalog still accounts for them.
owner_rule: a record whose parent_tool_use_id names a tool call belongs to the child core of that call (child:<id>); a record without one belongs to main (the contract's owner_routing)
rule_of_obligation: An obligation is a required canonical outcome: every native occurrence its trigger selects in a registered recording (counted from the native record alone, before any candidate output is read) must reach its destination in the owner's core with every stated value, and the oracle's own source profile must expect it. Retention of the containing record, a broad subtree disposition or another owner's passing check never discharges it. A residual is a reviewed token-named member that owes no canonical outcome (vendor_specific) or whose classification is an open question (unresolved); its path is an exact leaf, or an array or object whose listed members it covers; a residual owes nothing only once an Owner decision approves its classification at its digest. meaning_digest is sha256 over the canonical JSON of {owner_path, trigger, destination, observation, semantics}: a changed meaning needs a new revision. relevant_digest is sha256 over the canonical JSON of the extension definitions of the destination (its usage observation with every enum value, the unit member and the context kind) and the contract rules the obligation names: a change makes the binding stale until it is restated and reviewed. The review status written here is a label; only owner-decisions.json approves

obligations.semantics: the Agent tool's result (tool_use_result of the record whose single tool_result block answers an Agent request) reports, once at the call's end, the usage object of the child run's last metered model response: scope 7 Child run (whose activity: the child run the call spawned, unit = tool_call_uid), Final (the report is not revised), aggregation 3 Single response (what was measured: one response, not identified). Grounds: the retained Claude Code 2.1.304 emitter builds it from the last non-unmetered assistant message's usage over zero defaults; the Agent SDK 0.3.304 type gives it the shape of one response's usage with that response's iterations[]; in the 2.1.304 recording its input tranches equal the child's last streamed response (record 29), and in the 2.1.299 recording its cache read (13328) equals the earlier child call's cache creation. It is never the child run's consumption, never summed with the parent's, the run's or another observation, and never compared with the task figure as one measurement. A child without a metered response would report the zero defaults; no recording exercises that case
